name: std::deque<T,Allocator>::operator[]
intro: Returns a reference to the element at specified location pos. No bounds checking is performed.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 position of the element to return

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Unlike std::map::operator[], this operator never inserts a new element into the container. Accessing a nonexistent element through this operator is undefined behavior.

summary: Returns a reference to the element at specified location pos. No bounds checking is performed.
